stem: Which statement best explains why the observed fish appears to be closer to the surface than the actual fish?

options.label: A
options.text: When light travels from water into air, the light changes direction.

options.label: B
options.text: The light bounces off of the water and creates a reflected image of the fish.

options.label: C
options.text: When white light passes through the surface of the water, the light separates into colors.

options.label: D
options.text: The light enters the water and exits the water at the same angle.

visual_elements: A person stands on a lake shore looking at a fish underwater. A line from the person's eyes bends at the water surface and points to the 'Observed fish' above the 'Actual fish' underwater.
